messages:
Sam (PM): Quick sync on Embeddings Indexer v1 post-launch. We shipped last week; customers report a mix of minor ranking diffs and a few timeout spikes. Need to decide what is week+0 patch vs next enhancement wave. Proposed rule: any issue causing customer-facing correctness change (rank order changes >3% of queries) or timeouts that hit SLAs => patch. All else (tweaks to similarity threshold, UI wording, perf improvements under 20% reg improv) => enhancements.

Ivy (Eng): Fine with that. A couple specifics: 1) timeouts: if 95p latency > 1.5s we consider patch. 2) model-edge cases (e.g., embedding drift on long docs) may need a retrain which we'll treat as enhancement unless it's causing errors for a paying customer.

Diego (Data): For the rank-order metric, I can run a daily diff against the launch baseline and tag tickets with the delta. I'll also flag queries where top-3 changed.

Nora (CS): We got two enterprise tickets about result quality from AcmeCorp and OrbitalAI. Both asked to escalate. Per CS policy, we can mark a single-customer regression as P1 if they show clear business impact. I need the baseline diff from Diego to justify.

Harper (Design): For UX asks, require a before/after mock and acceptance criteria. Small copy fixes ok for patch if they unblock customers. Anything that changes visual layout goes to enhancements.

Mika (SRE): On rollout safety: plan for a 10% canary for any patch, monitor CPU/GPU and tail latencies. If tail latency > 2x baseline or error-rate spikes 4x, immediate rollback. ops-bot will create an incident note automatically on threshold.

Ivy (Eng): Implementation rule: if fix <= 3 dev-days and low infra risk, include in week+0. If it touches retraining, data pipeline, or infra sharding it's enhancement.

Sam (PM): Ok let's codify: cutoff timestamp for week+0 inclusion = 2025-11-07 23:59 UTC. Tickets created before cutoff that meet patch criteria get assigned to the hotfix board. Others go to the backlog. We'll publish a short owner list.

Diego (Data): I'll run the baseline diffs and post a CSV to the board by EOD today.

Nora (CS): I'll attach the two customer tickets and ask for permission to escalate one if Diego's diff confirms >3% rank change.

Ivy (Eng): I'll triage candidate bugs and estimate dev-days.

ops-bot: Canary job scheduled: embeddings-indexer-hotfix-2025-11-08 -> 10% for 30m.

Sam (PM): Final sync tomorrow 9:30am PT to lock the patch list. If anyone needs exceptions for customer escalations, bring evidence to the sync. :rocket:
